text:
Nora: Quick poll: toaster settings — 'light', 'legacy', or 'apocalypse'? Also drop your best one-liner. Ready, set, toast. :bread:
Ben: 'Legacy' is a mood. One-liner: "My phone battery and my toast both peaked at 100% this morning. Only one is still holding out." :battery:
Lee: Apocalypse is for breakfasts that mean business. One-liner: "I like my coffee like I like my code: hot and full of exceptions." :coffee:
Nora: (laughing) These are dangerously good. OpsBot: Kitchen note 89: toaster scheduled for cleaning at 3pm today. Please remove crumbs. :broom:
Ben: Also, if you press 'cancel' mid-toast you get a little triumph sound. Science. :trophy:
Lee: Counterpoint: the triumph sound is the toaster's plea for mercy. :sweat_smile:
Nora: Vote by reaction: :one: light, :two: legacy, :three: apocalypse. Bonus: drop your one-liner under the reaction.
Ben: (reacts :two:)
Lee: (reacts :three:)
Nora: Tally so far: legacy leads but apocalypse has style. Last call before crumb patrol.
OpsBot: Reminder: crumbs left in common toaster will be recycled into next snack budget. Not a drill. :money_with_wings:
Nora: New rule: winner of the one-liner duel gets to choose leftover snack night playlist. Stakes are high.
Ben: I accept these stakes. One-liner bonus: "We don't do bugs, only feature bread."
Lee: Final one-liner: "If the toast burns, call it artisanal." :sparkles:
Nora: Ok that's it. Results locked. Legacy wins and Lee wins the playlist (and a stern look from crumb patrol).
